record.final_answer:
Total shipping cost for October: **58.01**

The script doesn't run clean against these two files as-is, so be aware of what happened:

    $ sh scripts/cost.sh data/orders-2026-10.tsv
    cost.sh: no rate for zone "north" (order A-1001)
    exit=1

Cause: data/zone-rates.tsv has CRLF line endings, the orders file is LF, and cost.sh doesn't strip the trailing \r — so the rate table is keyed on "north\r", "south\r", "island\r" and every lookup misses.

Workaround without touching either file — cost.sh takes the rates path as a second argument, so I fed it an LF copy:

    tr -d '\r' < data/zone-rates.tsv > /tmp/hermes/cache/scratch/zone-rates.lf.tsv
    sh scripts/cost.sh data/orders-2026-10.tsv /tmp/hermes/cache/scratch/zone-rates.lf.tsv

Output (base + per_kg × weight):

    A-1001  north    2.4   6.94
    A-1002  south    0.8   6.28
    A-1003  island   5.0  15.25
    A-1004  north   12.0  15.10
    A-1005  south    3.3   9.03
    A-1006  north    0.6   5.41
    total                58.01

Cross-checked with an independent Python pass over the same data: 58.01. All six orders, no rows skipped.

The real fix is either converting data/zone-rates.tsv to LF or having cost.sh trim \r — say the word and I'll do whichever you prefer; I left both untouched as asked.
